config.${mod.id}:server_settings/${mod.i: When enabled, blocks broken by players will send their drops directly to the player's inventory instead of dropping them on the ground.
Uses the XP accumulated in the XP bar for the mending enchantment as if the XP was just picked up, automatically repairing items.
Allow instant kill in creative mode for all players.
Controls the vanilla behavior where items dropped from certain inventories are split into sub-stacks instead of dropping as full stacks. Set to false to drop items as full stacks.
Control how shulker boxes are stacked for all players on the server.
config.${mod.id}:player_settings/${mod.i: Configures how careful break is triggered for the player. When enabled, blocks broken by the player will send their drops directly to the player's inventory instead of dropping them on the ground.
Configures how XP bar mending is triggered for the player. Uses the XP accumulated in the XP bar for the mending enchantment as if the XP was just picked up.
Configure how creative kill is triggered (e.g., always, while sneaking, never).
config.${mod.id}:client_settings/${mod.i: When enabled, fireworks are consumed when used to fly with the elytra. When disabled, fireworks are not consumed.
Render flowers centered in the block.
When enabled, creative flying includes inertia and drag (vanilla behavior). When disabled, you stop immediately when releasing movement input.
Prevents mining blocks below the level of your feet, useful for digging perimeters layer by layer.
